# Zalty Boyz

> Zalty Boyz is a local surf school and adventure tour operator in Cocles, Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, on the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica (Limón province). We teach group and private surf lessons for all levels and run kayak, paddle board, night wildlife, and waterfall tours, mini surf trips to Isla Uvita and Cahuita, multi-day packages, massage, and weekly yoga classes. The website is available in English and Spanish.

## Business facts

- Name: Zalty Boyz (Google Business Profile: "Zalty Boyz Surf School")
- Address: Calle El Tucán, Cocles (primera casa mano derecha), Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, Limón 70403, Costa Rica
- Phone / WhatsApp: +506 8563 4224 — WhatsApp is the fastest way to book
- Hours: daily, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Payment: cash (preferred), SINPE Móvil, Zelle, PayPal, or bank transfer; prices in USD
- Team: Cedric McCrackin (founder & head surf instructor, ISA Level 1 certified surf coach, represented Costa Rica at the 2019 ISA World Surfing Games), Solomon McCrackin (surf instructor & videographer), Julie Hickey (massage therapist, yoga teacher, Reiki)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zalty_boyz/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@zaltyboyz6720

## Services and prices (USD)

- Group surf lesson: $60 — about 2 hours, max 4 students per instructor, transportation, board, rash guard, and snack included
- Private surf lesson: $70 — about 2 hours, 1-on-1, transportation and equipment included
- Kayak tour on the Cocles River: from $50 per person (private $60), about 2 hours
- Paddle board (SUP): from $50 per person
- Night tour & exotic fruit farm: from $45 per person (private $55)
- Waterfall tour (jungle hike to a swimmable waterfall): from $45 per person, about 3–4 hours
- Mini surf trip to Isla Uvita & Cahuita: priced per group on request
- Massage (Thai, deep tissue, Watsu, craniosacral, Reiki) with Julie Hickey: from $85
- Yoga with Julie Hickey at One Love Wellness (same location as Zalty Boyz): Tuesday 9:00 AM Vinyasa Hatha Flow, Wednesday 9:00 AM Breathe With Me Kundalini, Thursday 9:00 AM Vinyasa Flow. Drop-in $15, private class $60, class packages available
- Packages (per person, from): Surf & Relax $130, Weekend Taste of Puerto Viejo $170, Full Week Explorer $365

Prices are a guide; final rates are confirmed on WhatsApp and can vary with group size and season.

## Where we surf

Lessons go to whichever beach has the best conditions that day, with pickup in the Zalty Tuk Tuk: Cocles (home beach), Punta Uva, Playa Grande, and — for more experienced surfers — Playa Negra near Cahuita.
